claims.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
claims.text:
Packers LB Zaire Franklin, who missed last week’s game after getting accidentally kicked in practice, suffered a hairline fracture in his leg, sources say.

Green Bay did not place him on Injured Reserve, and they believe he can return while missing minimal games.

claims.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
claims.text: The Patriots are releasing their punter from the previous three seasons, Bryce Baringer, source says. He’s been on Injured Reserve, but is healthy now.

claims.author: rapsheet.bsky.social

claims.author: rapsheet.bsky.social

claims.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
claims.text: Broncos star CB Pat Surtain II, who has missed the last two games with an ankle injury, is unlikely to play today, source says. But there’s a good chance he’s back next week.

claims.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
claims.text: Jets star RB Breece Hall, attempting to return from a quad strain after missing three games, is unlikely to play today, sources say. He may work out to see if he can go, but Hall hasn’t been a full participant yet. It's a bit early.

claims.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
claims.text:
Panthers Pro Bowl CB Jaycee Horn is out indefinitely after suffering a quad injury in Sunday’s loss to the Browns, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

Horn is seeking a second opinion. But he’s likely to land on injured reserve and miss significant time.

claims.author: RotoWire
claims.text:
Jaylen Waddle: Uncertain to play Sunday. Waddle aggravated a previous chest injury during last week's 30-16 win over the Cardinals, and his status for Sunday's game against the Chiefs will be determined based on how he fares in practice this week, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update

claims.author: RotoWire
claims.text:
